title: StickForStats: A Statistical Analysis Platform with Automatic Assumption Validation
description:
StickForStats is an open-source, web-based statistical analysis platform that makes statistical-assumption validation a default precondition for every analysis. Its core is the Guardian system, a middleware pipeline of eight validators (normality, variance homogeneity, independence, outliers, sample size, modality, linearity, homoscedasticity) that checks assumptions before a test runs and, on critical violations, reroutes to an appropriate nonparametric alternative with a documented decision trail.

The platform pairs this validation layer with an autonomous test-selection engine, a manuscript statistical-consistency checker (statcheck-style), and reproducible case studies spanning genomics (RNA-seq differential expression), CRISPR strategy comparison, ordinal correlation, and clinical meta-analysis. A controlled calibration benchmark characterizes when the assumption-driven cascade improves Type I / false-discovery control.

Backend: Python 3.11 + Django REST Framework, SciPy/NumPy/statsmodels, optional 50-decimal precision via mpmath. Frontend: React. Deployable via Docker Compose. A Python client SDK and CLI are available on PyPI (pip install stickforstats). All analyses in the accompanying manuscript are reproducible from paper/replication/. MIT-licensed. Source: https://github.com/visvikbharti/stickforstats_new
